extras: Requires a separate local Khiip daemon to function.
intentEvidence: Capture + recall through your local Khiip daemon — URLs in, markdown in your vault, semantic recall over everything
problem: Users need a way to capture external URLs and retrieve relevant information from those captures using semantic search within their notes.

relations.evidence: The plugin is a thin client over the local Khiip daemon

summary: A client for the Khiip daemon that captures external URLs into the vault and allows semantic recall of captured content using a local AI service.
